mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. Conditions are clear at Harriet Park, though the air quality index is at a moderate 52. The moon is in its third quarter phase tonight, and we are looking at an overnight low of 66 degrees with no rain expected while you sleep.

Regarding city business, the Engineering Department continues its long-standing contract with AECOM Inc., with records of reports dating back years. Meanwhile, the Verona Senior Center is promoting their tri-shaw bike program, which offers free scenic rides for seniors on the Military Ridge State Trail, and the Recreation Department is currently hiring adult fitness instructors for the upcoming season.

We have a packed schedule starting today with Yoga at Insight Wellness and a live concert at Century School Park. Tomorrow, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run or Wisconsin Brewing Company, and later this week we have the Dane County Farmers Market on Saturday followed by Girls Try Hockey at the Verona Ice Arena on August 9th.

In a report from the Verona Police Department, an incident occurred on Thursday, July 31st, where a driver was arrested for O W I and cited for suspended registration after being stopped for driving with a flat tire.

The flavor of the day is the Chocolate Caramel Twist. Since the shop is currently closed, you can look forward to heading over when they open tomorrow at 10 AM, and remember that tomorrow's flavor will be the delicious Really Reese's.
